profile.headline: Senior Developer
profile.summary: I like to get the software done and get it done right.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Increased parallel programming throughput by converting Laravel Blade Web App into single page React web app with Laravel back end. This allows more people to work on the site at the same time.
- Improved team refactoring confidence level by increasing code coverage and cutting down testing speed.
- Standardized and decoupled service from third-party frameworks by developing company-owned library contracts and adapting third-party implementations to company-owned contracts.
- Standardized development experiences by defining and verifying version mechanism, code standard, code quality using Docker container and Jenkins pipeline.
- Helped explore static page website initiative through building site templates and integrating Hugo site generator into publishing chain.
- Improved Domain Driven Design team knowledge through discussions, pair, and mob programming.
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · Jenkins · Sonarqube · Redux · RabbitMQ · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Single Page Applications · React.js · Mqtt · PHP · Software Design Patterns · Node-RED

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
-  Developed collaboration systems(single page applications) to streamline collaboration between customers, sales, and freelance interior designers.
- Developed Trello bot, project management system to handle 3x number of projects with the same workforce.
- Developed a small-scale ERP system to provide a single source of truth for financial data, customer requirement agreements, and design materials.
- Developed CMS solution for interior design looks and linked project showcase based on Magento.

positions.title: Product Owner
positions.description:
- Restructured interior design process to improve efficiency.
- Improved whole house interior fulfillment process.
- Improved lead generation and management.

positions.title: Self Employed Developer
positions.description:
- Developed Shopify apps that helps generating sales, managing item fulfillment status, and recovering abandoned orders.
- Reduced 80% of Facebook content management effort by developing Chrome extension, Facebook scheduling service that can instantly scrape user-generated content, schedule post, reply fan post, message.
- Developed Drag and drop Wordpress theme that helps small businesses to quickly create their own website.
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · JavaScript · Facebook API · PHP · Wordpress Development · Shopify

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Integrated Magento 1.9 swatches feature and developed parent-child products module to support the new customer journey.
- Reduced 50% of customer complaints by developing a separate fulfillment system that sales, shippers, and buyers used to manage order item status at different fulfillment states.
- Expanded company business by integrating Odoo CRM service to help designers manage whole house interior design & fulfillment processes.
- Expanded multiple physical retail stores by integrating Odoo ERP with Magento to develop warehouse solutions.
- Improved Mobile SEO ranking by developing responsive Magento themes that function on both mobile and desktop devices.
- Reduced 30% marketing effort by developing a reusable block component for rapid landing page creation.

positions.title: Product Owner
positions.description:
- Increased 10x average order value by redefining customer journey.
- Analyzed and restructured fulfillment processes.
- Restructured interior design processes.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
- Brought the business back online by migrating violated core Magento 1.6 code changes to standardized Magento 1.9 without prior Magento experience.
- Increase 3x loading time with profiling, optimizing bottleneck code, and implementing static and dynamic cache.
- Scaled the online store during traffic spike sale events with AWS infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: Magento · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Bootstrap · HTML · PHP

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
- Revamped native no structure javascript code project by applying Backbone.js methodology to build separate modules.
- Improved code quality by proving unit testing suite for tree data handling with the relational database.
- Improved code structure by applying OOP design pattern to abstract data provider from API endpoint.
- Optimized landing page building experience by developing the base WordPress plugin, and themes platform for p5 landing page product.
- Developed multiple websites for different European clients using the p5 landing page system with LAMP stack.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Kohana Framework · JavaScript · MySQL · Backbone.js · Unit Testing · PHP

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
- Expanded Facebook page product suite by developing Facebook Page voting contest system app, Page partner app, Page analytic system using LAMP stack.
- Customized Facebook page app, web app integration through the iframe mechanism to help customers achieve their business targets.
positions.insights: Skills: Zend Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery · JavaScript · MySQL · Tortoise SVN · Apache · Backbone.js · PHP

positions.title: Project Manager, Account manager, Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as project manager, developer for location-based web app www.yum.vn
- Worked as an account manager, development project manager, and developer to support American's start-up project
